what: Seller describes transaction fee of 10% + $0.50 per sale as reason to quit Gumroad. Reports $16.59 in fees from total sales of $110.00.
verbatim_snippet: "I'm not even kidding, this single reason is enough to quit using Gumroad entirely. Sure, they are a free tool to use when you're just starting, but come on, A transaction fee of 10% + 0.50 per sale is way off the roof."
